lines.say: Welcome to Class 13. Arriving in Egypt: Airport, Immigration and Taxis.
Rule one. Use How much for prices and How many for things you can count.

show.text: Use How much for prices and How many for things you can count.

lines.say: Rule two. Use Could you or Can you to ask politely, and say please.

show.text: Use Could you or Can you to ask politely, and say please.
show.bn: নিয়ম ২: ভদ্রভাবে অনুরোধ করতে Could you অথবা Can you ব্যবহার করুন এবং please বলুন।
